title: What Eats the Dead
summary: To forge armour that can stand in front of a god you'll need Ether Ashes. Creatures killed while standing in blood, by a bone weapon (an Osseous sword or axe), leave ash. The church's blood pools work. Collect eight. (They're given back.)

goals.say: None of them spoke. None of them were Him. (The ashes go back in your pack.)
